# The Doxis management team

# Executive leadership

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/h/john-bates-hauptbild-fkbkmjfr6fbt9p5.jpg)

### Dr. John Bates

Chief Executive Officer

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/5/john-bates-detailbild-x7v8vetbzqnt4sb.jpg)

### Dr. John Bates

Chief Executive Officer

Dr. John Bates is Chief Executive Officer of Doxis. John is an experienced CEO, with over 25 years of industry experience. He is also Non-Executive Director of Sage Group PLC, a leader in cloud accounting and financial management software.

Prior to Doxis, John was CEO of Eggplant, a pioneer of AI-powered software test automation (acquired by Keysight Technologies), CEO of Plat.One, an IoT apps platform (acquired by SAP) and Founder/President of Apama, a pioneer of streaming analytics (acquired by Software AG). He has also served as a C-level executive in several public software companies, including Software AG and Progress Software. He holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from Cambridge University.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/z/Website_overview_page_Klutz-3z11qntj9y0ec5h.jpg)

### Johannes Klutz

Chief Financial Officer

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/g/Johannes_Klutz_table-987whs7mx3y2ax7.jpg)

### Johannes Klutz

Chief Financial Officer

Johannes Klutz is Chief Financial Officer of Doxis, responsible for Finance, Legal and IT. Johannes brings extensive experience in growth software, private equity and M&A to support Doxis’ continued growth and international expansion.

Prior to Doxis, Johannes served as Group CFO at PTV, later rebranded to Umovity and PTV Logistics, working closely with equity investors Bridgepoint. At PTV, he oversaw strong value creation across all financial KPIs with consistent double-digit growth as well as transformational M&A activity and strategic reorganization. During his time at Porsche SE’s Investment department, Porsche SE acquired PTV and invested in various startups. Johannes started his career at the Investment Bank Rothschild, dedicating five years to a number of European mid- to large-cap deals, including IPOs.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/t/Gregor_Joeris_350x400_2019-1pz7xh7d4v0erzh.jpg)

### Dr. Gregor Joeris

Chief Technology Officer

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/j/Dr.Gregor-Joeris-detail-rhv1bcs7yw19ccs.jpg)

### Dr. Gregor Joeris

Chief Technology Officer

Dr. Gregor Joeris is Chief Technology Officer of Doxis, responsible for product development and cloud operations. With more than 20 years developing technology at Doxis, Gregor led the reinvention and redevelopment of the core technology platform from a classic Document Management System to the modern, scalable, metadata-based Intelligent Content Automation platform rated by analysts today as the most advanced offering in the market.

As CTO, Joeris focuses on the delivery of continued technical innovation including the company’s AI strategy, while overseeing uniquely complex initiatives and contributing to the company’s overall strategic development. Gregor studied Computer Science at RWTH Aachen University and received his PhD on flexible workflow management at the AI lab of the University of Bremen.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/w/janine-trinkhaus-detailbild-ebfc3jemgcf6r5s.jpg)

### Janine Trinkaus

Chief People Officer

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/m/janine-trinkhaus-hauptbild-swthpq9km7y9qg6.jpg)

### Janine Trinkaus

Chief People Officer

As the Chief People Officer, Janine Trinkaus is responsible for the global HR strategy and people operations of Doxis. With a strong business focus, Janine brings extensive experience leading HR in rapidly evolving international software companies. Prior to Doxis, Janine was CPO at Questback (now Tivian), where she worked closely with the CEO, CFO and CTO on a strategic turnaround.

With nearly 15 years’ experience working in human resources, Janine places great value in the further development and advancement of employees. Encouraging togetherness, open lines of communication and a culture of trust are her biggest priorities. Together with her highly committed HR team, Janine’s mission is to underpin and empower the company to reach consistently higher levels of organizational performance.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/m/toby-donald-web-c-z4bnevytzjcf4g5.png)

### Toby Donald

Chief Customer Officer

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/m/toby-donald-web-c-z4bnevytzjcf4g5.png)

### Toby Donald

Chief Customer Officer

As Chief Customer Officer, Toby brings nearly 20 years of experience leading global customer teams and delivering outstanding satisfaction across enterprise software businesses. He oversees Customer Success, Professional Services, Managed Services, Support and eLearning, with a focus on scaling delivery excellence and maximizing customer value across key markets in the EU, UK, MEA and North America.

Prior to Doxis, Toby served as SVP at PTC, where he led global services and partner initiatives, achieved record CSAT scores and held full P&L responsibility. He also held leadership roles at ServiceMax and other software firms, contributing to three high-value exits worth a combined $3 billion.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/f/Andy%20Spence-xv9dc8m6ecnr8b0.png)

### Andy Spence

Chief Revenue Officer

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/f/Andy%20Spence-xv9dc8m6ecnr8b0.png)

### Andy Spence

Chief Revenue Officer

Andy Spence is Chief Revenue Officer at Doxis, responsible for the company’s global sales organization, including Solution Engineering and Revenue Operations. Andy is a highly accomplished commercial leader with extensive experience building and scaling high-performing go-to-market teams across both public and private equity–backed software companies.

Prior to joining Doxis, Andy served as Chief Sales Officer at Accelya, a leading enterprise software provider for the airline and travel industry. He previously led EMEA North at Qlik, playing a key role in driving growth at the global business intelligence and analytics leader. Earlier in his career, Andy held senior roles at Microsoft, HP, Fujitsu, and Adobe, giving him deep expertise across enterprise software, SaaS, and complex global sales environments.

Andy is known for his customer-centric approach, focus on operational excellence, and passion for developing strong teams. He is based near London in the UK.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/3/SER-WillMcInnes-web-c-3rcae2vghwjek4v.jpg)

### Will McInnes

Chief Marketing Officer

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/7/SER-WillMcInnes-web-c-detail-3d41jh5z247as1h.jpg)

### Will McInnes

Chief Marketing Officer

As Chief Marketing Officer, Will McInnes is responsible for all marketing and communications activities. Will’s primary focus is driving new business growth, working closely with the company’s sales leaders, while unlocking the full potential of Doxis' brand in the global ECM market.

Will has a successful track record in profitably scaling businesses and growing global brands for European tech firms. Prior to Doxis, McInnes was the CMO of Ultimate (generative AI for customer support) where he helped to double revenue in 18 months, and Brandwatch (global leader in social media analytics, acquired by Cision/Platinum Equity), where the team scaled from Series B to beyond £100m in revenues and EBITDA profitability. In 2012, Will’s book _Culture Shock_ was published by Wiley.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/q/SER_douglas_cardoso_a-w6a59tz5n629dsn.jpg)

### Douglas Cardoso

Senior VP Products

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/8/SER_douglas_cardoso_b-8rg9nrkr0gp1hkk.jpg)

### Douglas Cardoso

Senior VP Products

As Senior VP of Products, Douglas Cardoso manages the entire product portfolio strategy of Doxis. Since taking the role, Douglas has launched a number of strategically important Cloud and AI initiatives, as well as elevating the role of UX and structured customer feedback via a user group. For Douglas, product management plays a crucial role in a company’s success and requires strategic thinking, entrepreneurship, curiosity, deep understanding of customer challenges, and industry knowledge.

Prior to Doxis, Cardoso was a Lead Product Manager at OpenText. With a B.Sc. in Systems Analysis and Computer Science and over 10 years of industry experience, Douglas has designed and developed digital products for a wide variety of sectors. His unwavering fascination for innovation and how technology can benefit people have been his compass throughout his career.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/s/Yeelen%20Knegtering-y1yqh5shmhppyn2.jpg)

### Yeelen Knegtering

Chief AI Officer

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/s/Yeelen%20Knegtering-y1yqh5shmhppyn2.jpg)

### Yeelen Knegtering

Chief AI Officer

Yeelen Knegtering is the Chief AI Officer of Doxis. With a degree in Information Technology from the University of Groningen in the Netherlands, Yeelen is passionate about developing digital products with AI that help people to save time on administrative hassles and focus on the things they love. In his role as Chief AI Officer, Yeelen leads Doxis' company-wide AI strategy. This includes AI implementation, ethics and governance, bridging technology and business objectives to drive innovation, efficiency, and new revenue opportunities.

Yeelen is also the founder and CEO of the AI company Klippa, an intelligent document processing solution (IDP) provider acquired by Doxis in March 2025. He started Klippa based on the idea that there had to be a better way to organize and manage receipts for business leaders. Yeelen lives with his family in Groningen and loves classic cars – both driving and preserving them.
